mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.spot_name, sp.photo_url, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating, c.name AS category_name, sc.name AS sub_category_name, s.keywords, f.created_at AS favorited_at FROM favorites f JOIN spots s ON f.spot_id = s.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sub_categories sc ON s.sub_category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN categories c ON sc.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN spot_photos sp ON sp.spot_id = s.id AND sp.display_order = ( SELECT MIN(sp2.display_order) FROM spot_photos sp2 WHERE sp2.spot_id = s.id ) LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.spot_id = s.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY s.id, s.spot_name, sp.photo_url, c.name, sc.name, s.keywords, f.created_at ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorites f JOIN spots s ON f.spot_id = s.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
